personas.name: completionist mapper
personas.goal: Visit every area, collect all 5 coins, gems, relics, keys and hearts, open every locked door, and finish the level with the timer as high as possible.
personas.style: Methodical. Uses goto:x,y to reach each unexplored tile, checks the map after each door and lever, and tracks coins, keys and score against the map. Finishes with Finish and Play again.

personas.name: sequence-breaker
personas.goal: Reach the exit or important items early or by unintended routes: dash over gates and doors, use a key on the wrong door, step onto the exit before collecting everything, and fall into spikes on purpose to reach areas.
personas.style: Experimental. Uses dash tokens into walls and closed gates, dashes in the same tick as a step, pulls levers while standing on them, and tries to reach the exit with 1 life and with 0 keys.

personas.name: chaos tester
personas.goal: Break timing: press pause, esc, enter and movement in the same tick, pause on the exact tick of a pickup, hit, respawn or finish, restart mid-level, and spam Enter and click:btn-resume while the game is running.
personas.style: Rapid and noisy. Uses combined tokens such as pause+left, up+down+left, use+pause, and mixes click:<id> with keyboard tokens during dialogs and transitions. Repeats the same action several times to see whether state drifts.

personas.name: literal newcomer
personas.goal: Follow the design document one sentence at a time and check each claim literally: start at (1,1), one move per tick, dash recharge reads 'Dash 5' right after a dash, 300 ticks timer, pause freezes everything, Restart level resets to the start.
personas.style: Slow and careful. Reads the HUD after every tick and compares it to the stated rules. Writes down each sentence and tests it once with a clean setup, without combining inputs.

personas.name: economy auditor
personas.goal: Drive score, lives, keys, coins and timer to their limits and verify every amount: 5 lives cap with heart giving +500, spikes losing 500 with score floored at 0, score never above 999,999, timer hitting 0 costing a life, time bonus of 10 per tick left.
personas.style: Numeric. Records state.score, lives, keys, coins and timeLeft before and after every event and checks the delta against the table in the document. Lets the timer run out on purpose and stacks hearts at full lives.

personas.name: photographer
personas.goal: Open every dialog and menu (pause menu, Game over, Level complete, victory) and check what is shown, which buttons exist, whether each visible button is on top, and whether the text matches the state.
personas.style: Observational. Pauses and resumes repeatedly, reads ui entries for every visible button and dialog, and clicks each button with click:<id> to confirm it works. Checks that the Game over dialog shows Retry and that no button is covered.

checks.rule: The player starts with 3 lives, maximum 5, and never below 0.
Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999.
The timer runs from 300 down; it is never above 300 or below 0.
Dash recharge is between 0 and 6.
Dash is ready exactly when the recharge is 0.
Coins are between 0 and 5 and keys are never negative.
The HUD bar always shows the current score.
The HUD bar always shows the current lives.
The HUD bar always shows the current keys.
The HUD shows Coins n/5 with the current coin count.
The HUD shows the ticks left on the timer.
The HUD shows 'Dash ready' at recharge 0 and 'Dash n' otherwise.
A dash sets the recharge to 6 and it counts down at the end of the tick, so right after a dash the HUD shows Dash 5.
The player makes at most one move (a step or a dash) per tick, and it is never diagonal.
checks.expect: (state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || state.player.y == prev.state.player.y) && abs(state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 2

checks.rule: Walls, closed gates and locked doors are solid: the player never stands on them.
checks.expect: tile(cur, state.player.x, state.player.y) != '#' && tile(cur, state.player.x, state.player.y) != 'D' && tile(cur, state.player.x, state.player.y) != '='

checks.rule: Enemies patrol floor only and never stand inside a wall.
While paused nothing moves: player, enemies, timer, dash recharge and toasts are frozen.
checks.expect: state.player.x == prev.state.player.x && state.player.y == prev.state.player.y && state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && state.dashCooldown == prev.state.dashCooldown && state.enemies == prev.state.enemies && state.toast == prev.state.toast

checks.rule: The timer drops by exactly 1 at the end of every running tick.
Score only decreases through spikes or a restart.
Spikes cost one life and 500 points, floored at 0; spikes always hurt.
checks.expect: state.score == max(0, prev.state.score - 500) && state.lives == max(0, prev.state.lives - 1)

checks.rule: Touching an enemy costs one life and no points.
Enemies cannot hurt the player during the tick of reappearing or the next 4 ticks.
After losing a life the player reappears at (1,1).
After losing a life you keep everything you have collected, including keys picked up in the same tick.
A heart gives +1 life up to 5; at 5 lives a heart gives +500 score instead.
Restart level puts the level back to start: score 0, 3 lives, all items back, running straight away.
checks.expect: state.score == 0 && state.lives == 3 && state.coins == 0 && state.keys == 0 && state.timeLeft == 300 && state.mode == 'playing'

checks.rule: At 0 lives the game is over: the Game over dialog appears with a Retry button.
The pause menu with Resume is shown only while the game is paused.
Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.
Stepping onto the exit shows the Level complete dialog with a Finish button and the time bonus of 10 per tick left.
checks.expect: any(ui, u => u.kind == 'dialog' && u.visible && includes(u.text, 'Level complete')) && state.bonus == 10 * state.timeLeft

value.notes: Round 1, photographer persona. No prior coverage, so this round focuses on breadth of menus. Check on every pause and dialog: the dialog text matches state.mode, each visible button has top=true, and the HUD matches state. Watch for buttons hidden under others and for stale text after restart. Pause-plus-move in the same tick should freeze the player (design says the rest of the tick is ignored). Click each button once to confirm it works. Later rounds can push toward game over and the victory dialogs if these plans do not reach them.

plans.purpose: Pause menu cycle: open with P, Escape, and Enter; resume by each route; check that pause+move in one tick does not move the player; click Resume and Restart.
Walk toward the exit and reach the Level complete and victory dialogs; click Finish and Play again, checking button tops and text.
Lose lives on purpose: stand still near enemies and spikes until Game over, then read the Retry button and click it; also test the timer-out path.

Check after each step that the HUD matches state (score, keys, coins, lives, timer, dash). Watch for swaps with enemies, invulnerability after respawn, and pause ticks that should not move anything. Next round, reuse whichever seeds reveal doors, levers and the exit.

plans.purpose: Sweep the map with goto walks, then probe pause, resume and restart while items and doors are in play.
Probe dash recharge boundaries, same-tick multi-key input, and pause timing during a dash.

value.notes: Round 1, no prior coverage. Timer expiry (300 ticks) cannot be reached inside one 120-token plan, so the timer-zero life loss and the time-bonus check need a longer run from another persona or a later round. Map layout is unknown, so the goto targets are guesses; unreachable targets expand to nothing, which is harmless. For every tick, record score, lives, keys, coins and timeLeft before and after, and check the delta against section 4 and section 5. Pay special attention to the 5-life heart (+500, not +1 life), spikes at low score (floor at 0), and whether the HUD matches state after pause and restart.

plans.purpose: Walk the map collecting items; check coin, gem, key and heart deltas against the table and watch for HUD/state mismatch.
Drive score to 0 and probe the spikes floor and life cost; repeat hits to check invulnerability rules.
Dash, pause/restart and dialog buttons; check dash recharge display, restart resets score to 0 and lives to 3, and Enter/Finish paths.

value.notes: Round 1: no shared coverage yet, so this round is about breadth. Chaos focus: same-tick pause plus movement, repeated Enter and resume clicks while running, and restarts mid-level. Check state against HUD and UI after every tick. Watch for score or lives drift after repeated pause/resume cycles, and for a dialog that stays open or a button that is covered. Tokens are kept simple so any failure can be minimized afterwards.

plans.purpose: Pause and movement collisions in one tick, then repeated Enter and resume clicks while running.
Pause on or near pickups, hits and spikes, plus dash and movement spam to probe timing and state drift.
Restart mid-level and then immediately repeat inputs to check that the reset state and HUD stay in sync, and that Enter or resume clicks do not leak into the new run.

value.notes: Round 1: no prior notes, no map layout known yet, so plans use goto and generic probes. Focus: dash into walls and closed gates (should not use up the dash when the first tile is solid), dash and step in the same tick, pause combined with movement in one tick, use on floor and on levers, and pressing Enter, Escape, or clicks on dialog buttons. Check that the HUD matches state and that the timer and dash recharge freeze while paused. Next round, read the tiles from state and aim goto at the real levers, gates, spikes and exit.

plans.purpose: Dash into the starting walls and probe dash-vs-step and pause-in-same-tick behaviour from the start tile.
Walk toward the exit with 0 keys and 1 life, use levers while standing on them, and check that Enter and clicks on the Resume button close the pause menu cleanly.

value.notes: Round 1, literal-newcomer pass. No coverage exists yet, so this round checks the basic sentences one at a time. Read the HUD after every tick and compare it with the state. Check: the start is at (1,1); one move per tick; after a dash the HUD reads "Dash 5" and returns to "Dash ready" after 6 running ticks; pause freezes the timer, dash recharge and toasts; Restart level resets score, lives and items; the timer starts at 300. Keep inputs separate except where a plan explicitly combines them (pause+left, which tests that the rest of the tick is ignored). Re-check each claim with a clean setup before reporting anything.

plans.purpose: Dash recharge countdown, pause freeze, resume, and restart from a clean start.
Same-tick input ordering with pause, and walking to lever and gate area.
Timer expiry at 300 ticks: confirm the life loss, timer reset to 300, and HUD agreement.

value.notes: Round 2 chaos notes. Seeds 42, 7 and 123 showed no violations: pause+move ticks ignored the move, Enter and resume clicks while running did not leak, and restart reset score, coins and time correctly. Still unverified: pausing on the exact tick of a coin pickup or spike hit, a key pickup followed by a restart, and a hit or respawn with pause on the same tick. Check every tick that HUD text matches state, that paused ticks freeze timer, dash and toasts, that no dialog stays open after Resume or Enter, and that score and lives never drift across repeated pause/resume cycles. Watch for a covered button (top=false) in any dialog. Tokens were kept simple so failures can be minimized.

plans.purpose: Pause on the exact tick of the coin pickup at (4,1), then spam Enter and resume clicks and pause cycles to check score/coin drift.
Collect a coin and a key, restart mid-level from the pause menu, then repeat inputs right after restart to check that the reset state and HUD stay in sync and that no key or coin carries over.
Walk into spikes and enemies while toggling pause on the same tick as the likely hit or respawn, checking lives, score floor at 0, invulnerable count and dash state.

value.notes: Map (seed 42 tiles): lever L at (1,8); gate = at (8,3); spikes ^ at (3,3) and (5,8); key k at (4,5); locked door D at (10,6) (only door, only key); exit E at (12,7), reached via (10,7),(11,7). Relic R (10,7), hearts h (3,8). Keys 1 = doors 1, so the door route must be used. Dash into solid tiles should not spend the dash; dash into the door while holding the key should bump and keep the key. Not yet verified: exit-with-0-keys, dash onto spikes mid-dash, pause freezing dashCd, btn-next behaviour. Round 1 showed the enter/esc pause loop works and HUD matched state; no violations so far. Next: check door bump with key, spike hit on dash midpoint, and gate toggling with lever.

plans.purpose: Pick up the only key, then dash into the locked door (should bump, key kept), then step through and reach the exit.
Use the lever from its tile to open the gate, then dash over spikes on purpose and check pause freezes the dash recharge.
Dash into the closed gate with a dash ready and try dash-plus-step in one tick and pause plus dash in one tick.

value.notes: Round 2 notes. Clean HUD agreement so far: start (1,1); one move per tick; dash sets Dash 5 and returns to Dash ready after 6 running ticks; pause freezes timer, dash recharge and toasts; timer starts at 300; walls bump. Candidate issue (seed 12345): after pause -> click:btn-restart, state shows mode 'paused' with the pause dialog still up, and right presses do not move the player. Design says restart runs the game straight away. Possible softlock/state_desync. Second (seed 7): pause+left on (1,1) logged [pause,bump] while paused, which conflicts with 'rest of the tick is ignored' (input_race). Not yet covered: timer expiry (needs about 300 ticks), gameover/retry, Finish/Play again, spikes, levers/gates, exit.

plans.purpose: Confirm whether Restart level from the pause menu leaves the game paused, with clean inputs.
Check whether a paused tick ignores its movement key (pause+right from (2,1)), then resume and move.
Check that Restart from pause resets timer, score and position, then the player can move while running.

value.notes: Round 2 notes. Round 1 covered pause/resume routes and the Restart and Next/Again click paths, but the clicks on btn-resume, btn-restart, btn-next, btn-retry and btn-again all came back "not-visible" in most runs. Only the pause dialog was seen; gameover, complete and won were not reached. Pause+move in one tick froze the player correctly. Next round: reach Game over through spike hits (spikes at (3,3) and (5,8)) and read Retry. Then walk the key/lever/door route to the exit for Level complete and victory, and click every button once with a top check. After restart, check the HUD for stale values.

plans.purpose: Reach Game over by stepping on spikes at (3,3) three times, read the Retry dialog and its top flag, then click Retry and check the HUD reset.
Lever opens the gate, key opens the door, then walk to the exit for Level complete and victory; click Finish and Play again.
Pause+move collisions, pause during a pickup, then restart and check HUD and toasts reset after a score was earned.

value.notes: Round 2 leads. (1) Seed 42 #26-#27: score went 100 to -300 with no life lost; design says score never goes negative. Then #53 spikes at (3,3) gave score 64736 from -300, a jump that looks like overflow or wrap. HUD matched state. Reproduce and minimise. (2) Seed 7 #42-#43: paused with a toast on screen, btn-resume shows top=false and the click hits the toast. Likely ui_overlap. (3) Seed 1234: gameover at #57, inputs frozen as designed; Retry was never clicked while visible. Next round: reuse seeds 42, 7, 1234; test toast-over-button with resume and restart; test gameover Retry by click and Enter; check exit and doors on any seed that reveals them.

plans.purpose: Reproduce the negative-score and score-jump on spikes near (3,3)/(3,6). Watch score after each spike hit and check it stays in 0..999999.
Collect the key, then pause while the toast is visible and click btn-resume and btn-restart. Check whether the toast covers the button (ui_overlap) and whether toasts and timer freeze during pause.
Reach gameover again and test Retry by click, then Enter, and check that lives, score and timer reset as the design says. Also check dash and pause are ignored while gameover is shown.

value.notes: Round 1 findings (economy audit). Score underflow: spikes at low score wrap instead of flooring at 0. Seed 7: 300 -> 65336. Seed 99: 100 -> 65136. Seed 42: score reached -300. Spike lives cost (-1) is correct. Restart from the pause menu (seed 99): after click:btn-restart the mode is 'paused' with no dialog, and movement is ignored. The design says restart runs straight away; needs confirming. Heart at 3 lives (seed 42, tick 23): 'heart' event fired but lives stayed 3; verify. Heart at 4 lives (seed 7) gave +1 life correctly. Not yet covered: 5-life cap (+500), timer expiry (too long for 120 tokens), time bonus, score cap 999,999. Next: confirm wrap and restart issue from fresh game; look for heart at 5 lives.

plans.purpose: Confirm spikes at score 100 wrap instead of flooring at 0, then check whether restart from the pause menu leaves the game running.
Spike hit at low score (100): check the floor at 0 and the one-life cost.
Collect the heart at 3 lives, then hit spikes at score 200 to check the floor at 0 with lives tracking.

value.notes: Round 3 (final). Carry-over candidates: (A) seed 12345: after pause then click:btn-restart, state reads mode 'paused' with the pause dialog still up, and right presses do not move the player. Design says Restart runs the game straight away. Two independent runs gave the same result. Re-confirm with minimal tokens. (B) seed 7: pause+right from (2,1) moved the player to (3,1) with events [pause,move] while mode became paused. Design says the rest of a paused tick's input is ignored. Re-confirm. HUD agreed with state elsewhere; timer, dash recharge and toasts froze during pause. Uncovered: timer expiry, Game over Retry, Finish and Play again, levers and gates, exit, time bonus.

plans.purpose: Re-check the pause+move candidate: does a movement key pressed in the same tick as pause move the player?
Minimal re-check of the Restart-from-pause candidate: is the game still paused after Restart level, and does it accept moves?
Explore the lever and exit path to cover gates, the exit and completion dialogs, and check HUD agreement along the way.

value.notes: Round 3 economy audit. Confirm from a fresh game before reporting: (1) spike score wrap. Seed 99 went 100 -> 65136 and seed 42 went 100 -> 65136 on a spike hit, which looks like uint16 wraparound (65536 - 400). Score should floor at 0. (2) Restart from the pause menu leaves mode 'paused' with no dialog, and movement is ignored. The design says restart runs straight away. (3) The seed 42 heart at 3 lives needs a recheck. Limits to note: the map has only one heart (3,8) and one spike at (5,8) on the seed 7 layout, so the 5-life cap and the +500 heart are not reachable with hearts alone. Timer expiry needs 300 running ticks, which is more than the 120-token plan limit, so it is not testable in one plan. Score cap 999,999 is also out of reach at this map's totals (max about 25k).

plans.purpose: Confirm the spike score wrap from a fresh game, then check whether restart from the pause menu leaves the game paused with movement ignored.
Collect the heart at 3 lives to reach 4, then hit spikes at score 200 to check the zero floor, the one-life cost and the invulnerability countdown.
Repeat the spike hit at score 100 to confirm the wraparound and check the Dash HUD and invulnerability after respawn.

value.notes: Round 3: Game over, Level complete and victory were never reached in rounds 1-2. Seed 4242 reached Game over at #11 (3 spike hits at (3,3)); Retry was shown but btn-retry was only clicked after Enter had already restarted. Seed 777 showed a toast ("Key collected") over btn-resume: top=false and click hit-other:toast at #24-25, a candidate ui_overlap not yet confirmed from a fresh replay. Seed 12345 pause+right moved the player and pause+down bumped on resume; check the bump against pre-pause state. Lever at (1,8), key near (4,5), locked door at (10,6) reached from (10,5); verify with tiles. No complete or won modes yet.

plans.purpose: Reach Game over by three spike hits at (3,3), read the Retry dialog and its top flag, then click btn-retry directly and check the HUD reset.
Walk the lever/key/door route to the exit, check Level complete and Finish, then Play again. Also test the toast over btn-resume.
Pause during a pickup and a restart, then check the HUD and toasts for stale values after restart.

value.notes: Round 3. Strongest lead: spikes add about 65036 instead of subtracting 500. Seed 1234 went 300 to 65336 and seed 42 went -300 to 64736. 65036 = 65536 - 500, which looks like a 16-bit unsigned wrap on the spike penalty when score < 500. Plan 1 tests this minimally from score 0. Seed 7 ui_overlap (toast over btn-resume) is unconfirmed: the pause UI at #44 showed no toast, so re-test with a toast visible at pause. Gameover Retry by click and Enter is still untested. Seed 1234 exit and doors are still unexplored. Coverage remains partial.

plans.purpose: Minimal repro of spike score wrap: score 0, spikes at (3,3), expect score 0 and lives 2.
Pause while a gem toast is visible; check toast vs btn-resume/btn-restart overlap, then resume.
Reach gameover by three spike hits, then test Retry by click and check reset of lives, score, timer and dash.

value.notes: Round 3 focus: sequence breaks. Seed 42 geometry: the gate at (8,3) is the only link between the west half (start, key, lever) and the east half (door, exit). Lever at (1,8) opens it. Key (4,5) opens D (10,6), reached via (9,3),(9,4),(9,5),(10,5). Exit (12,7) is reached via (10,7),(11,7). Seed 7 spikes at (3,3) and (5,8) can be used for mid-dash spike tests. Round 2 data showed a dash from (1,1) to (1,3) spending the dash in an enemy-free corridor, so keep enemy timing in mind. Still unverified: exit with 0 keys, dash over a spike on the midpoint tile, dashCd frozen by pause, gate toggled twice with use, btn-next after level complete. Checks not yet run: HUD vs state on the complete dialog and the Finish click.

value.notes: Round 3 findings. (1) Likely softlock, seed 4242: click:btn-restart from the pause menu leaves mode=paused with no dialog. Restart should resume play at once. Moves, Enter, Esc and resume clicks then do nothing. Class: softlock. (2) Likely input_race, seed 999: pause+right at (3,1) moved the player to (4,1) and collected a coin on the pause tick; pause+left at #16 also moved the player. The doc says pause ignores the rest of that tick's input. (3) Likely state_desync, seed 999: HUD Time disagrees with state after click:btn-resume ticks (#17: state 287, HUD 288; #25: state 281, HUD 282) and stayed stale through #28. Enter-resume did not show this. Next: confirm all three on fresh replays and minimize. Combos use key tokens only.
